findings.finding: The October registered-direct investor holds up to 653,381 freely tradable registered shares (116,545 common plus 536,836 pre-funded warrants exercisable at $0.007), bought at about $6.12 and now 43% under water. Post-deal volume (1.78M shares over 10-09 to 10-13) is the right size for that position to be still unwinding into the window.
findings.mechanism_in_window: The shares and pre-funded-warrant shares were sold off the effective S-3 (333-275608), so they can be exercised and sold on Oct 14 with no further filing. Nothing in the SPA shown limits the purchaser's sales after the announcement. The selling is continuing supply, not a dated, finished event.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After the Oct 8 pricing the next three closes were -16.22%, -17.46% and today about -10%. After the Sept 2026 offering/resale cycle the falls alternated between continuation (-15.34%, -15.88%) and violent rebounds (+17.58%, +63.55%) (baseline history).
findings.why_not_priced: The price has taken the fact of dilution but not how much of the 653k registered shares remain to be sold. If the seller were finished, today's tape would show the gap being bought (intraday is only +0.3% off the open, with the low at 3.23) rather than 840k shares trading flat at the lows.
findings.independence: The volume signature from the daily bars (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/BIAF?range=1mo&interval=1d) is consistent with it but does not identify the seller. No 13G or Form 4 was found.

findings.finding: The company cannot issue or announce new common stock, or use its ATM, inside the window. SPA §4.12(a) bars any issuance until 30 days after the Effective Date, the ATM carve-out opens only 30 days after the Effective Date, and the ATM prospectus was suspended on Oct 8. The commonest second leg down for a microcap, a fresh offering priced overnight, is ruled out for Oct 14.
findings.mechanism_in_window: A contractual bar that runs through the whole window, dated by the Oct 8 SPA. It lands here because it removes the event that most often produces the next-session gap for names like this.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This issuer has raised repeatedly: Oct 2025 RD at $2.50, Aug 2026 PIPE, Oct 2026 RD. Its own falls after earlier raises continued when a new raise followed. None can follow inside this window.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: it is public. Its value is relative to the other fallers ranked today, many of which carry an open ATM that can be drawn tonight. A price that held it would show no discount for an overnight raise, which the tape cannot show directly.
findings.independence: The 8-K Item 8.01 suspends the ATM until a new prospectus supplement is filed: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1712762/000149315226046548/form8-k.htm
